selection: Direct-value smoke experiment, two independent TinyStories evaluations, source-informed Qwen study, and every session009-014 of one MCP-only Qwen continuation study. Selection is by workflow milestone, not positive performance.
redaction_policy: Replace local project/run/home/data/tmp paths and local username with documented placeholders; redact recognized API/GitHub/HF/AWS credential patterns. Preserve numeric JSON values, booleans and historical hash fields. No metric recomputation or model execution.
omissions: full datasets and long-form generation files
private client configurations, account state and caches
verification_scope: Published byte integrity and parseability only. Original digests identify retained local originals; they do not authenticate unavailable originals or prove experimental conclusions. Historical embedded digests may reference omitted or pre-redaction files.
